Stakeholder engagement
Our stakeholders help us to develop by providing an external perspective on what and how Triodos Bank does its work. We also partner and co-create to further Triodos Bank's mission and the sustainability agenda.
Stakeholder engagement
Networks and partners
Introducing the Triodos Bank Impact Collective
With the Triodos Bank Impact Collective, we are introducing an innovative model for stakeholder consultation. The Impact Collective is an advisory board that is open to all interested stakeholders in the Netherlands. The collective will advise on the transition themes at the request of Triodos Bank itself or on its own initiative.
Want to know more? Reach out to us via email.
Send us an email
Triodos Bank continually seeks to connect with the world around it. This is essential if we are to remain relevant, continue to progress and meet our frontrunner ambition. All our business and financial decisions have an impact on our stakeholders. In turn, the societal themes embraced by our stakeholders have an impact on what we do now and how we do it.
We have benefited from open discussions with our stakeholders for many years and in varied ways from client days connecting hundreds of customers in all the countries where we work, to meetings and surveys with investors in the bank itself – the depository receipt holders.
Not only do we consult stakeholders because we value their feedback on our policies and actions, we also engage with them because we strive to change finance. We use our influence to change a financial system so that it puts people’s interests first while allowing us to live within our planetary limits. We cannot achieve that on our own; to truly have impact we need the support from stakeholders.
Triodos Bank identifies three general stakeholder categories:
Those that have economic relationships with the business
Those without an economic relationship but with a close interest in Triodos Bank from a societal perspective
Those that provide new insights and knowledge
The specific stakeholder groups relevant to Triodos Bank are: NGOs, investors, co-workers, suppliers, media, financial sector, advisers/inspirers, governments.
In addition to numerous interactions throughout the year at all levels of our organisation, we follow a formal process to analyse which issues are most important to our stakeholders and to inform our material topics. We do this through an annual meeting and survey. Our material topics are listed in the Annual Report.
Customers, investors, co-workers and suppliers
Customers
The relationships and interaction between clients, entrepreneurs and co-workers is at the heart of our approach to our work. We value learning from the thoughts and perspectives of our customers, as well as being inspired by them in our daily work.
In the Netherlands we organised several webinars in 2024, specifically aimed at mortgage clients to provide more information about making your home more sustainable and other living arrangements. Also, we held several customer panels about accessibility of our services.
For our
business customers
we organised several events. By sharing knowledge, inspiring each other, and combining our strengths, we collectively create more impact. That is why we find it important to meet regularly and undertake activities together.
The Triodos Bank UK annual
‘Let’s Talk Impact’ customer meeting
is a moment in the year when all customers are invited to hear from the senior leadership team, ask questions and connect with the impact we have as a bank. In 2024, it was a live broadcast online on the theme of future generations and shared on YouTube.
Triodos Bank UK works with high-profile customers that are willing to endorse the bank and what we stand for, for example national TV wildlife presenter
Chris Packham
.
In Spain, we organised several events for customers and clients, to help them navigate the challenges of today. Topics ranged from decarbonisation and energy saving to mental health. The biggest of them all was our celebration of the 20th anniversary of Triodos Bank Spain. We also invited customers and clients to the opening of our new commercial office in Madrid.
In Berlin, 200 customers and guests visited Triodos Bank Germany’s tbchange event. During lively panel discussions, renowned experts debated the changes that our economy and society urgently need, including our chief economist, Hans Stegeman. T
o meet customers locally, Triodos Bank Belgium set up 10 pop up offices all over the country. In addition, Triodos Bank Belgium has been working on renewing the Sustainability Label for 5 of its savings products, a strong indication of value for our (future) customers.
Depository Receipt Holders
In 2024 Triodos Bank had intensive contact with its DR holders in all countries where we are active. Various meetings were organised with DR holders. In addition, we held two Extraordinary Meetings of Shareholders and our Annual General Meeting.
Co-workers
In 2024, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion (EDI) remained a crucial focus at Triodos Bank, reflecting our ongoing commitment to our values of equity, and wider social impact. We continue to build on the Triodos Bank Group Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion Policy (EDI Policy), through the implementation of strategy across areas of data and reporting; policy and process; co-worker engagement; and communication and awareness.
The EDI policy outlines our commitment to fostering an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels empowered to contribute. Throughout 2024, Triodos Bank engaged in various initiatives aimed at promoting awareness and understanding of EDI principles.
In October 2024 we organised Identity Week. Identity Week is a new initiative to celebrate, and create more awareness and understanding of the main parts of our identity, values and behaviours. Triodos Bank also participated in the European Mental Health week in all five countries. The aim was to raise awareness about the importance of mental health in our everyday lives. We offered OneBank activities, as well as local activities.
To connect co-workers with one another and the organisation, online weekly meetings were organised in all countries where Triodos Bank has banking activities. Also, several groupwide meetings for all co-workers were held and surveys were held among co-workers about working at Triodos Bank.
In the Netherlands, over 500 colleagues took part in the Experience Days 2024. Spread over three days, 13 exceptional, diverse business clients opened their doors to us, so that we could experience the transformative power of money with our own eyes.
With the support of the Triodos Bank Inclusion Forum, Triodos Bank UK has been able to continue to give focus to key areas of inclusion in 2024: Black History Month, mental health awareness, menopause awareness, and neurodiversity. We are recognised as a Disability Confident Level 1 ‘Committed Employer’. Triodos Bank UK has also held regular ‘Ask Us Anything’ lunches hosted by the senior management team, inviting a randomly selected group of co-workers from all levels within the organisation.
In Spain events were organised around Women’s Day and LGBTIQ+ and co-workers facilitated internal workshops. In Belgium the focus on more co-worker engagement, resulted in more frequent emailing to co-workers on hot topics and the reintroduction of live Triodos Community Meetings.
In Germany, our engaged co-workers joined several marches for climate protection. In November 2024, co-workers took part of a historically significant event: the cleaning of Stolpersteine (stumbling stones) – commemorating the expulsion of Jews and other victims of persecution during the Nazi era.
Suppliers
Triodos Bank further strengthened its engagement and awareness with vendors/suppliers in 2024.
We seek to maintain good relationships with our suppliers and business partners. We strive to build connections between suppliers to help them share best practice and gain insights into making a positive impact.
Triodos Bank wants to support its suppliers to become more aware and contribute positively on issues around sustainability, corporate social responsibility, ethics and transparency.
NGOs, financial sector, government and media
Non-Governmental Organisations (NGOs)
Triodos Bank supports numerous civil society initiatives that are in line with our transition themes. In 2023, Triodos Bank was the first bank to
support the Fossil Fuel Non-Proliferation Treaty initiative
, a global effort to foster international cooperation to accelerate a transition to renewable energy for everyone, end the expansion of coal, oil and gas, and equitably phase out existing production in keeping with what science shows is needed to address the climate crisis. We worked closely with the initiative in gathering support calling on governments to create this treaty at COP28.
In the Netherlands, we were one of the initiators of the citizens' initiative Farewell to Fossil Fuels (Afscheid van Fossiel), an appeal to the House of Representatives to truly start working on phasing out fossil fuels. Together with 25 other organisations we mobilised the support of more than 42,500 Dutch citizens.
In 2024, Triodos Bank joined the Right to Repair coalition. Together with coalition members, we want to contribute to a faster development of laws and policies in the field of repair, exchange knowledge and support innovative repair initiatives.
Triodos Bank UK has supported the
Money Movers
resource hub in partnership with Friends of the Earth. Money Movers is a movement of people supporting each other to take climate action with their personal finances.
In the UK, in 2024 we
coordinated an open letter
, signed by 70 businesses, calling for parliamentary candidates to support the UK Climate and Nature Bill, a proposed framework legislation that could provide a plan to tackle both the climate and nature emergencies.
Triodos Bank UK supports the Centre for Thriving Places in its work to help put the wellbeing of people, place and planet centre stage. In 2024, we sponsored the publication of a
'Wellbeing Economy in Action’ report
showcasing stories of local leaders.
Memberships for Triodos Bank UK include Green Alliance, The Climate Coalition, the Aldersgate Group and
Business Declares
, a peer business network for business-declaring an ecological and climate emergency.
In Germany, we have joined the Bundesverband Nachhaltige Wirtschaft (German Sustainable Economy Association), which brings together 700 innovative companies to drive forward economic and social change, by showing how it can be done and advocating further positive change.
In Spain, we participated with WWF and Oxfam Novib on events about the Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive and collaborated with Ecodes, Ongawa and Oxfam in support of the Fossil Fuel Non Proliferation Treaty. Triodos Bank Netherlands is active in MVO Nederland and Transparency International NL.
Financial sector
Part of our mission is to change finance. This makes the financial sector one of our most important stakeholders. We interact with our colleagues in the sector on a regular basis, in person, through banking associations or during events.
Triodos Bank is a member of several local, regional and international platforms and associations, consisting of a diverse set of organisations, such as the Global Alliance for Banking on Values (GABV), the Global Impact Investing Network (GIIN), B Corp (which includes a wide range of companies, not all active in the financial sector), United Nations Environment Programme Finance Initiative (UNEP-FI), United Kingdom Social Investment Forum (UKSIF) and many more.
We are also active in the European Banking Federation (EBF), in the Dutch Association of Banks (NVB) we taken an active role in several sustainability committees; and in Spain we are a member of Spanish banking association AEB, Spainsif, SpainNab and the Green Finance Institute. The managing director from Triodos Bank Germany is a member of the sustainable finance council of the federal government and
coordinates the climate commitment of the German financial sector.
In Belgium, Triodos Bank actively positions itself within the financial sector by building strong relationships with important organisations. The most important points of contact include Febelfin, Woman in Finance and IFB Impact Finance. Through these networks, Triodos Bank strengthens its presence and influence in the sector, focusing on sustainability and inclusivity in the financial world. In addition, we endorse major partnerships with organisations including The Shift Biodiversity and work with the largest NGOs on a daily basis, in order to increase our impact.
Triodos Bank the Netherlands is one of the organising partners of Springtij, a convening space that brings together business, government and civil society actors to look at sustainability issues from an integral point of view.
Government
Triodos Bank has ongoing dialogues with local and (inter)national governments and supervisory bodies, sometimes in partnership with other financial institutions or other partners. It engages in conversations about the sector and has regular meetings to discuss issues that are relevant to its business.
Key topics it focuses on in conversations and consultations include the positive impact and potential of sustainable banking, the strength of greater diversity in the banking industry and the need for stricter regulation to face out fossil fuels and creating more attention to biodiversity.
Media
Triodos Bank’s profile has developed rapidly in recent years in all the countries where it operates, via coverage in the media in particular. In addition to media coverage, Triodos Bank uses newsletters, social media, such as Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, and its corporate and Colour of Money websites to communicate news, attract new co-workers and to engage with stakeholders interested in its story.
In 2024, we held interviews with a number of mainstream media such about sustainable banking and impact investing. We also launched a new podcast called Money for Change. In Spain, more than 30 media/journalists participated in events organised by Triodos Bank.
Triodos Bank UK CEO has a
regular column in the Metro newspaper
– one of the largest circulated newspapers in the country – with a focus on sustainable banking. In 2024, Triodos Bank UK has sponsored a podcast series ‘
If I ruled the world
’ with celebrated TV presenter Gillian Burke and a new documentary ‘
Sea, Land and City
’ hosted on the Waterbear streaming platform, highlighting inspiring nature restoration projects in the South West of the UK. We also partnered with the 2024
Ethical Consumer Conference
, focused on discussions around degrowth and post-growth. Chief Economist Hans Stegeman visited London to speak at the event.
Triodos Bank NL has a proactive media policy, where we approach the press with our reasoned, newsworthy view in response to news or a development. Examples where we actively inform press are new projects we are funding and our view on transitions. In the Netherlands, Triodos Bank Chief Economist Hans Stegeman has a weekly column in magazine Vrij Nederland and a monthly opinion piece in newspaper Het Financieel Dagblad.

In Germany, Triodos Bank is regularly reported on in the financial and business press, as well as in media focusing on sustainable topics - e.g. Ecoreporter, Utopia, Tagesspiegel Background Sustainable Finance and Handelsblatt Business Briefing Nachhaltige Investments.
Triodos Bank has achieved top rankings in surveys of top German economic media. For example, in a consumer study by Handelsblatt, we were once again recognised as the best sustainability bank in 2024, with the best customer advice and the highest level of trust. In the Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung's analysis, we were recognised as the best customer advisor and most trustworthy company among German direct banks,
Advisors and inspirers, local communities
Advisors and inspirers
To expand its activities, enrich its thinking and keep innovating in its products and services, Triodos Bank engages with external advisors who respond to requests or provide advice spontaneously, and seeks out individuals who inspire new opportunities and insights. Triodos Bank invites inspiring people to speak at specially convened sessions in its branches, and at international theme meetings. These people are vitally important, particularly in the development of forward looking sustainability strategies.
We also continue to be active as a certified B Corp. B Corporations are businesses that balance purpose and profit. They are legally required to consider the impact of their decisions on their workers, customers, suppliers, community, and the environment. This is a community of leaders, driving a global movement using business as a force for good.
In 2024, Triodos Bank Germany launched a partnership with nachhaltig.kritisch, a young, innovative team of climate podcasters who get to the bottom of climate issues and scrutinise green filter bubbles.
Former comedian and famous TV science journalist Dr Eckart von Hirschhausen managed to introduce the serious topic “Healthy Earth - Healthy People” in a funny way. He demonstrated the direct health relevance of climate change at an event of Triodos Bank Germany in April 2024.
Local communities
Triodos Bank aims to involve local communities in its mission and to let them benefit from our activities. A few highlights worth mentioning come from the UK.
We continued to deepen our work on equity, diversity and inclusion – engaging our co-workers and Bristol community around Black History Month, PRIDE and more throughout the year. A local partnership with social enterprise Babbasa provides the bank with ongoing training and recruitment support.
When hate and violence flared in the UK streets in the summer of 2024, we made public statements and stood firm in our belief in the power of unity and the strength of a diverse society.

Networks and partners
We partner with a number of others who share our commitment to advancing impact investments in a transparent and sustainable way.
Overview of corporate networks and partners
Carbon Disclosure Project
The Carbon Disclosure Project is an independent non-profit organisation that collects information regarding greenhouse gas emissions of the world's largest corporation. Triodos Investment Management is a signatory member of the Carbon Disclosure Project, Water CDP, Climate Action and Forest Footprint Disclosure Project.
www.cdp.net
FIEC
Triodos Investment Management is a member of the
Financial Inclusion Equity Council, a forum of leading equity investors in the financial inclusion sector.
www.centerforfinancialinclusion.org
Dutch Banking Association (NVB)
The NVB is the link between the banking sector, the government and the public and contributes to a vital and sustainable sector. Triodos Bank is a member.
www.nvb.nl
DUFAS
The Dutch Fund and Asset Management Association promotes the collective interests of asset managers operating on and from the Dutch market – both Dutch and foreign parties. Triodos Investment Management is a member.
www.dufas.nl
Eumedion
Triodos Investment Management is a participant in Eumedion, which represents institutional investors’ interests in the field of corporate governance and related sustainability performance.
www.eumedion.nl
Women’s World Banking
Women's World Banking, a global non-profit devoted to giving more women access to finance.
www.womensworldbanking.org
Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials (PCAF)
PCAF is a global partnership of financial institutions that work together to develop and implement a harmonized approach to assess and disclose the greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions associated with their loans and investments.
www.carbonaccountingfinancials.com
The Fossil Fuel Non-Proliferation Treaty Initiative
The Fossil Fuel Non-Proliferation Treaty Initiative is a global effort to foster international cooperation to accelerate a transition to clean energy for everyone, end the expansion of coal, oil and gas, and equitably phase out existing production in keeping with what science shows is needed to address the climate crisis.
www.fossilfueltreaty.org
​​​​​​​
Global Alliance for Banking on Values
The Global Alliance for Banking on Values (GABV) is an international network of frontrunner organisations and leaders in the banking industry that use finance to serve people and the planet. Our collective goal is to make the banking system more transparent and support positive economic, social and environmental change.
www.gabv.org
Eurosif
Triodos Investment Management is member of the European Sustainable Investment Forum (Eurosif), a pan-European network and think-tank whose mission is to develop sustainability through European financial markets. We are a signatory to its European SRI Transparency Code. We are member of some local sustainable investment fora, for example VBDO (Netherlands), UKSIF (UK), SpainSIF (Spain) and FNG (Germany), which all promote responsible investment in their own markets.
www.eurosif.org
GIIN
The Global Impact Investing Network is a not-for-profit organisation dedicated to increasing scale and effectiveness of impact investing. Triodos Investment Management is a founding member.
www.thegiin.org
Hivos
Hivos-Triodos Fund, one of the four Triodos microfinance funds, is a joint initiative of Triodos Bank and Hivos.
www.hivos.org

NPM
This Dutch Platform for Inclusive Finance promotes inclusive finance as a contribution to poverty alleviation in developing countries. Triodos Investment Management is a member.
www.inclusivefinanceplatform.nl
UNPRI
Triodos Bank is a signatory to the United Nations Principles for Responsible Investment, which provide a framework for investment professionals to incorporate the environmental, social and corporate governance issues into mainstream investment decision-making and ownership.
www.unpri.org
Partnership Biodiversity Accounting Financials (PBAF)
The Partnership for Biodiversity Accounting Financials (PBAF) is a partnership of financial institutions that work together to explore the opportunities and challenges surrounding the assessment and disclosure of the impact on biodiversity associated with their loans and investments.
www.pbafglobal.com

Samen werken aan duurzame verandering
Triodos Bank wil samen met haar gemeenschap bouwen aan een duurzamere financiële wereld. Dat doen we met het Triodos Bank Impact Collective (TBIC): een raadgevend orgaan waarin betrokken mensen meedenken en adviseren over de impactstrategie van Triodos Bank.
Als lid van deze raad kan je samen met anderen de Raad van Bestuur van Triodos Bank advies geven over de transitie naar een duurzaam en sociaal inclusief systeem en zo verschil maken. Onderaan deze pagina kun je je aanmelden.
Wat maakt het TBIC bijzonder?
Wat het TBIC uniek maakt, is de directe invloed die je als lid hebt op de impactstrategie. Triodos Bank stelt alleen vragen waar we het antwoord ook echt van willen weten, en we nemen de adviezen van het TBIC in principe over – of leggen helder uit waarom dat in een specifiek geval niet gebeurt.
Dit maakt de invloed van het TBIC concreet en transparant.
Wat is het doel van de TBIC?
Het Impact Collective zorgt ervoor dat ideeën, adviezen en zorgen van stakeholders een belangrijke plek hebben in de besluiten van Triodos Bank over impact. Als lid denk je mee over onderwerpen zoals duurzaamheid, sociale rechtvaardigheid en hoe geld kan bijdragen aan positieve verandering.
Je advies telt mee en Triodos Bank laat altijd weten wat er met de inbreng van het TBIC gebeurt.
Hoe werkt het lidmaatschap?
Toegankelijk en vrijwillig:
Iedereen met motivatie kan zich aanmelden. Je deelname is vrijwillig.
Inbreng op maat:
Bij aanmelding kun je het onderwerp aangeven waarover je wilt meedenken. Zo zorgen we ervoor dat bijeenkomsten aansluiten bij jouw interesse en expertise.
Flexibele betrokkenheid:
Twee keer per jaar vindt er een bijeenkomst van de TBIC plaats, op het hoofdkantoor van Triodos Bank – vlakbij station Driebergen - Zeist. Je wordt uitgenodigd voor die bijeenkomsten die aansluiten bij ‘jouw onderwerp’. Kun je een keer niet, dan kun je je natuurlijk afmelden.
Reiskostenvergoeding:
Om deelname voor iedereen mogelijk te maken, vergoeden we reiskosten als dat nodig is.
Voor wie is het TBIC?
Het Triodos Bank Impact Collective is er voor alle stakeholders: iedereen die zich verbonden voelt met onze missie en wil meedenken over onze impactstrategie.
Het TBIC bestaat uit elf stakeholdergroepen:
Certificaathouders
Spaarders en beleggers (retailklanten)
Duurzame ondernemers (zakelijke klanten)
Medewerkers
Maatschappelijke organisaties
Financiële sector
Beleidsmakers
Onderwijs en wetenschap
Toekomstige generaties
Betrokken burgers en bewegingen
Natuur
De TBIC gaat over zes thema’s
Op de agenda komen onderwerpen te staan die direct aansluiten op de activiteiten van Triodos Bank. Dat zijn vragen die in de praktijk bij ons echt spelen en waar we intern nog geen helder antwoord op hebben. Daarom is het belangrijk om jouw mening te horen; of je inhoudelijk expert bent of niet.
De onderwerpen hebben altijd te maken met een van deze thema’s:
Voedseltransitie: van een systeem dat de natuur uitput naar landbouw die de bodem herstelt, met eerlijke ketens en gezonde voeding.
Grondstoffentransitie: van het eenmalig gebruiken van grondstoffen naar het slim en zorgvuldig omgaan met hulpbronnen.
Energietransitie: van fossiele energie naar hernieuwbare en efficiente energie.
Welzijnstransitie: an materialisme naar een economie die het welzijn van mensen koestert.
Maatschappelijke transitie: van een samenleving die draait om concurrentie en verdeeldheid naar een samenleving gebaseerd op samenwerking en solidariteit.
Financiële systeemverandering: van focus op winst naar een eerlijk en duurzaam financieel systeem dat bijdraagt aan positieve maatschappelijke verandering.
Zo verloopt een TBIC-bijeenkomst
Twee keer per jaar komt het TBIC bij elkaar op het hoofdkantoor van Triodos Bank, vlakbij station Driebergen-Zeist. Altijd in de middag, meestal op donderdag of vrijdag, en uiterlijk tot 17.00 uur, met een borrel na afloop. Deze bijeenkomsten zijn in het Nederlands.
Uiterlijk vier weken voor een bijeenkomst ontvang je een uitnodiging met de adviesvraag. Uiterlijk één week ervoor ontvang je aanvullende documentatie. We gaan ervan uit dat de voorbereiding niet veel meer dan een uur kost.
Elke bijeenkomst gaat over twee specifieke onderwerpen.
We mikken op ongeveer vijftien tot 25 deelnemers per onderwerp, zodat er ruimte is voor een echt gesprek.
Als er meer aanmeldingen zijn, zullen we loten. Alle leden kunnen altijd online hun input geven, ook als zij niet fysiek aanwezig zijn.
Er is een onafhankelijk facilitator, die ervoor zorgt dat alle deelnemers de ruimte krijgen het woord te nemen.
Er is altijd minimaal één lid van de Raad van Bestuur aanwezig bij elk onderwerp.
Aan het einde van het gesprek stemmen de aanwezigen over de adviesvraag. Hiervoor geldt dat een meerderheid een advies moet steunen.
Van elke bijeenkomst maken we een geanonimiseerd verslag. Het conceptverslag wordt ter controle voorgelegd aan een aantal aanwezigen (bijvoorbeeld twee of drie deelnemers).
Een verslag van het gesprek en het advies, inclusief argumenten voor en tegen, worden gepubliceerd op onze website. Wederom anoniem.
Wat doet Triodos Bank met een TBIC-advies?
Elk advies, inclusief het verslag, van de TBIC wordt besproken door de Raad van Bestuur. Het advies wordt in principe overgenomen door de Raad van Bestuur. Na uiterlijk acht weken geeft de Raad van Bestuur een formele reactie.
De Raad van Bestuur laat altijd weten wat er met het advies gebeurt:
Het advies wordt overgenomen en de Raad van Bestuur licht toe hoe het advies wordt overgenomen.
Of ze legt helder uit waarom bepaalde adviezen niet worden opgevolgd.
We communiceren hierover op onze website.
Waarom meedoen?
Je hebt directe invloed op de impactstrategie van Triodos Bank.
Je ontmoet inspirerende, betrokken mensen.
Je draagt bij aan duurzame en maatschappelijke verandering.
Je krijgt toegang tot relevante informatie en bijeenkomsten.
Hoe meld ik me aan?
Als je je aanmeldt, kies je het thema dat jij het meest relevant en interessant vindt. Je hoeft niet een inhoudelijk expert te zijn.
Bijkomend voordeel is dat je als TBIC-lid ook kan worden uitgenodigd voor andere interessante evenementen, zoals een filmvertoning in het bos, of lezing bij ons op kantoor.
Wanneer je gekozen thema op de agenda van een bijeenkomst staat, nodigen we jou uit om op ons kantoor De Reehorst met elkaar en de Raad van Bestuur in gesprek te gaan.
Staat jouw thema (nog) niet op de agenda of kun je niet aanwezig zijn, dan kun je altijd online je perspectief delen op de adviesvraag. Online input wordt samengevat en gebruikt als vertrekpunt voor de dialoog tijdens de fysieke bijeenkomst. Ook wordt de online input meegenomen in de uiteindelijke advisering en verslaglegging.
Bij een groot aantal aanmeldingen voor een bepaald thema of een specifieke bijeenkomst werken we met loting voor de bijeenkomst op ons kantoor. Daarbij vinden we het belangrijk dat alle stakeholdergroepen goed vertegenwoordigd zijn. We streven ernaar de groep in de zaal niet groter te maken dan 25 personen, zodat er ruimte is voor een echt gesprek. Alle leden kunnen altijd online hun input geven, ook als zij niet fysiek aanwezig zijn.
Je bepaalt zelf hoe lang je lid blijft. Je kunt je op elk moment uitschrijven voor de nieuwsbrieven en uitnodigingen die we versturen.
Deelname is vrijwillig en laagdrempelig. We hanteren geen minimale inzetverplichting: je bepaalt zelf hoe vaak en op welke manier je bijdraagt. Om deelname voor iedereen mogelijk te maken, vergoeden we reiskosten als dat nodig is.
Word lid van het Triodos Bank Impact Collective
Denk mee over de duurzame koers van Triodos Bank. Kies de thema’s die bij jou passen en draag met jouw ideeën bij aan positieve verandering.

Information pop-up:
Voedseltransitie:
van een overwegend uitputtend voedselsysteem naar regeneratieve landbouw, eerlijke ketens en gezonde diëten.
Grondstoffentransitie:
van lineair gebruik van grondstoffen (winnen, gebruiken, afdanken) naar een economie waarin hulpbronnen op waarde worden geschat en verstandig worden gebruikt.
Energietransitie:
van een energiesysteem gebaseerd op fossiele energieproductie naar hernieuwbare energie en energie-efficiëntie.
Welzijnstransitie:
van een focus op materialisme naar een economie die individueel welzijn op een diepere manier koestert.
Maatschappelijke transitie:
van een samenleving die concurrentie en verdeeldheid stimuleert naar een samenleving die geworteld is in solidariteit en samenwerking.
Financiële systeemverandering:
we veranderen de regels van het financieel systeem zodat geld stroomt naar positieve maatschappelijke impact in plaats van korte-termijn winstmaximalisatie.

Maximaal aantal deelnemers
Omdat we geloven in de waarde van een echte dialoog heeft elke bijeenkomst een maximum aantal deelnemers. Als er zich meer deelnemers hebben aangemeld voor een bepaald onderwerp, zullen we leden door middel van loting uitnodigen.

World Circular Economy Forum
Open invitation to join the Triodos Bank accelerator session on institutional set-up for a circular transition
At this year’s World Circular Economy Forum (WCEF), on the 16th of May Triodos Bank will host an accelerator session titled ‘Global Insights: Institutional Set-Up for a Circular Transition’. The growing demand for natural resources is depleting the planet’s reserves and degrading ecosystems. In response to this Triodos Bank has
continually called
for a shift from a wasteful, linear economy to a restorative, circular one.
This session examines how various institutional frameworks are set-up and identifies the optimal approach for advancing the circular economy. Participants will gain insights on what makes up the enabling environment for circular business and finance - what works and what doesn’t? And who is driving the transition towards circularity - governments or businesses?
Join us for this exciting session and contribute to a growing research initiative on institutional drivers of circularity by
registering here
!
What can you expect of this session?
Newest insights linking institutional quality to circular economy outcomes
Audience engagement to connect findings to real-world professional experiences
Relevant policy and company examples from each continent
A discussion of approaches in South America specifically, since this year’s WCEF is hosted in Brazil
